intent: generate — new map UI using existing images as style references
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished, premium PC game island map interface for the original Chinese narrative exploration game 《来自月亮的 Z》. Landscape 16:9, high resolution. This is a NEW island overview screen, not a route-planning popup and not a collage.
Reference input 1 (06-private-dialogue): definitive visual style, coastal architectural language, materials, atmosphere, pine silhouettes, rich painterly realism, dusk indigo and warm amber. Reference input 2 (12-escape-plan): only borrow restrained charcoal UI surfaces, warm white Chinese typography, fine imperfect linework and coral navigation; do NOT copy its flat schematic composition or its escape-stage content.

Composition: a beautifully illustrated compact island occupies the left 76% and center of the screen, fully visible in a three-quarter bird's-eye cartographic view, ringed by deep blue-violet sea with fine foamy waves, jagged grey rock cliffs, layered pine woods, winding lit coastal footpaths, boardwalks and staircases. Hand-painted textured terrain, strong restrained shapes and subtle cinematic light, NOT toy-like low-poly, NOT a photograph, NOT parchment. A natural horseshoe bay faces the bottom left. Island silhouette is clearly readable; enough negative water space around it. Upper woods have a little mist, quiet and subordinate. The right 22% has one airy dark translucent detail area with a very fine vertical boundary, not many boxed cards. Elegant editorial spacing, game interface rather than website. Corners have subtle vignette, NOT illegibly dark. Four landmarks should have readable distinct silhouettes at map scale. Only ONE lighthouse anywhere.

Geography and connected traversable paths:
1. Lower-left sheltered harbor: a small wooden dock, tiny moored boat, a few warm-windowed houses forming a street, visitor kiosk. This is the player's current position. A small warm-white triangular player marker on the shore walkway.
2. Mid-left above the bay: the sea-facing café with red-brown awning and broad wooden terrace overlooking the water, a few table shapes. A continuous selected CORAL route follows actual visible stairs/walkway from the player marker at the harbor to this café. Coral ring pin at café. This is the one active destination.
3. Upper-middle plateau: the broadcast hall and attached prop store, understated large coastal timber studio with antenna and service courtyard, connected by a winding pale footpath to the café and the lighthouse peninsula.
4. Upper-right tip of island (but LEFT of the sidebar): a SINGLE white cylindrical lighthouse with glowing amber lantern, dark cap and little maintenance outbuilding. A clearly connected cliffside path from the broadcast hall arrives at its OUTSIDE terrace. Only its short INTERNAL entrance has a small amber lock symbol; do not lock the whole district.
All four areas on ONE compact connected island. Thin pale routes follow real terrain. No paths across sea, no random isolated nodes, no other destination labels. Keep land and buildings visible beneath labels.

UI exact Simplified Chinese, sharp, legible, professionally typeset modern humanist sans Chinese, generous tracking only on small top labels. All Chinese text must be correctly spelled. No English decorative headlines.
Top left two text lines with generous margin:
“小岛地图”
“第 5 日 · 休息时段”
Top right, small outlined keycap and text:
“Esc  返回”
Four subtle floating map labels with fine leader lines attached to their actual landmarks, no bulky boxes:
At harbor: “码头小街” and beneath in smaller text “访客角 · 你在这里”
At café: “海边咖啡馆” in coral, with a tiny coral diamond indicating selected destination
At studio: “直播厅与道具间”
At lighthouse: “灯塔工作区” and beneath smaller amber “内部需要权限”
Sidebar exact text, only these lines:
small coral kicker “已标记目的地”
large warm-white “海边咖啡馆”
thin quiet horizontal line
small muted heading “已知安排”
body “Z 的休息地点”
body smaller “来源：今日工作安排”
small muted note “是否在场，抵达后确认。”
generous blank space
outlined understated coral button with small flag icon: “取消标记”
below in muted text, split across two lines naturally:
“步行不推进时段”
“正式活动开始前确认耗时”
Bottom left a thin unobtrusive legend: triangle “当前位置” / coral stroke “标记路线” / pale stroke “已知通路” / tiny lock “受限入口”.
Bottom right small keyboard/mouse hints: “滚轮  缩放” and “拖动  平移”.
No other text, no metrics, no meters, no unnecessary decoration or marketing. No fast-travel button, no live GPS tracking of Z or patrols, no safe zone labels, no quest checklists, no migration spoilers, no countdown, no extra lighthouse, no grand new landmarks. Atmospheric but navigation-first. Consistent indigo #151C2B, muted purple #4B465D, restrained amber #E8B16D, coral #F17C68, ivory #EFE9DF. Refined hierarchy, text sits on quiet terrain or subtle charcoal scrims, not atop busy roofs. One clear selected route, wide restful spacing, detailed coast as the hero.
